info.title: Rippletide Agent Evaluation API
info.description: Public API for evaluation agents, test prompts, test results, and knowledge imports

ApiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyAuth.description: Platform API key for authenticated account-level API access

Agent.description: Evaluation agent registered in Rippletide. This record tells Rippletide what external agent endpoint to test and how to store evaluation results.

id.description: Unique agent identifier returned by Rippletide. Use this ID in later evaluation API calls.

name.description: Human-readable name for this evaluation agent.

seed.description: Deterministic seed used by the evaluation setup. Use any integer; the CLI generates one automatically.

numNodes.description: Evaluation graph size hint. Use 100 unless the Rippletide team recommends another value.

publicUrl.description: Public HTTPS endpoint for the agent Rippletide should evaluate.

advancedPayload.description: Optional request payload template used when Rippletide calls the agent endpoint. Omit this for standard chat-style APIs.

CreateAgentRequest.description: Register an external agent endpoint so Rippletide can run evaluations against it.

name.description: Human-readable name for the evaluation agent, such as Support Bot Eval.

seed.description: Deterministic seed for the evaluation setup. Use any integer; 123 is fine for manual calls.

numNodes.description: Evaluation graph size hint. Use 100 for normal integrations.

publicUrl.description: Public HTTPS endpoint for your agent. Rippletide calls this endpoint when it runs tests.

advancedPayload.description: Optional request payload template for non-standard agent APIs. Omit this unless your endpoint does not accept the default message payload.

label.description: Set to eval for public evaluation workflows.

UpdateAgentRequest.description: Update the evaluation agent metadata, endpoint URL, or request payload template.

numNodes.description: Updated evaluation graph size hint. Use 100 for normal integrations.

publicUrl.description: Updated public HTTPS endpoint for your agent.

advancedPayload.description: Updated request payload template for non-standard agent APIs.

KnowledgeItem.description: Knowledge entry attached to an evaluation agent.

label.description: Question, title, or short label for the knowledge item.

description.description: Answer or source content used during evaluation.
description.example: Customers can request a refund within 30 days of purchase.

type.description: Public evaluation workflows should use knowledge.

node_count.description: Number of graph nodes created from this item, when available.

CreateKnowledgeItemRequest.description: Add a knowledge item or expected answer source for an evaluation agent.

label.description: Question, title, or short label for the knowledge item.

description.description: Answer or source content used during evaluation.
description.example: Customers can request a refund within 30 days of purchase.

type.description: Public evaluation workflows should use knowledge.

TestPrompt.description: Question and optional expected answer used to evaluate an agent response.

id.description: Numeric prompt identifier. Use this ID when submitting a result for the prompt.

prompt.description: Question or task sent to the evaluated agent.

expectedAnswer.description: Optional answer used as the reference for evaluation.
expectedAnswer.example: Customers can request a refund within 30 days.

testAnswer.description: Latest answer captured for this prompt, when available.
testAnswer.example: Customers can request a refund within 30 days of purchase.

CreateTestPromptRequest.description: Create one or more prompts to evaluate against an agent.

prompts.description: Prompts to add to the evaluation suite.

prompt.description: Question or task sent to the evaluated agent.

expectedAnswer.description: Optional answer used as the reference for evaluation.
expectedAnswer.example: Customers can request a refund within 30 days.

UpdateTestPromptRequest.description: Update one evaluation question and its optional expected answer.

prompt.description: Updated question or task sent to the evaluated agent.
prompt.example: What is your refund policy for annual plans?

expectedAnswer.description: Updated reference answer used during evaluation.
expectedAnswer.example: Customers can request a refund within 30 days of purchase.

TestResult.description: Stored evaluation result for one prompt.

promptId.description: Prompt ID this result belongs to.

sessionId.description: Optional session identifier associated with the result.

response.example: Customers can request a refund within 30 days of purchase.

expectedAnswer.example: Customers can request a refund within 30 days.

hallucinationLabel.description: Hallucination label returned by the evaluator, when available.

hallucinationFindings.description: Fact-level findings returned by the evaluator.

SubmitTestResultRequest.description: Submit the agent response and evaluation outcome for a prompt.

response.example: Customers can request a refund within 30 days of purchase.

hallucinationLabel.description: Optional hallucination label returned by your evaluation step.

hallucinationFindings.description: Optional fact-level findings returned by your evaluation step.
